STEP 1 - Scene: A plated home-style meal of baked/roasted chicken pieces (bone-in, skin-on, golden and seasoned) served with seasoned brown rice (rice cooked with tomato/paprika-type coloring).

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white rectangular-rounded dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 531 cm^2. The food sits in the center and upper-right; the plate is mostly visible.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Chicken pieces (two bone-in pieces: a drumstick/thigh section on the left and a larger piece in the center, with some visible bone and skin)
- Seasoned rice (brown-orange rice, spread across the upper right and right side)

STEP 4 - Area:
- Chicken: ~18% of vessel area (~95 cm^2)
- Rice: ~22% of vessel area (~117 cm^2)
- Total food coverage ≈ 40% (scattered crumbs and the plate rim are excluded)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Chicken: 95 cm^2 x 2.0 cm (pile height, bone-in pieces) ≈ 190 ml
- Rice: 117 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 175 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken: 190 ml x 0.9 ≈ 171 g (cooked, includes bone, so a reasonable bone-in edible estimate is ~130 g; I use 130 g to account for bone)
- Rice: 175 ml x 0.8 ≈ 140 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken (roasted, skin-on, bone-in, edible part): ~200 kcal/100 g → 130 g → 260 kcal
- Seasoned cooked rice (with oil/seasoning): ~150 kcal/100 g → 140 g → 210 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 270 g of food total on a 26 cm plate covering ~40% of the surface is plausible for a moderate single serving with bone-in chicken. Total ≈ 270 g, ≈ 470 kcal.
